description: European company registry lookup: one profile schema for every country (identity, legal form, status, head office, VAT, LEI, register link). Registers from local copies: Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, Romania, Sweden; live: Czechia, Finland, Poland, Slovakia, Switzerland; Denmark and the United Kingdom live through this profile; elsewhere via GLEIF (LEI). Poland (KRS): the status reads the proceedings entered in the register extract (bankruptcy, liquidation, restructuring, suspended activity: autre, procedure and date in statut_detail) and the strike-off (cesse, wykreślenie and its date); a proceeding not yet entered in the register is not seen. Country blocks: NACEBEL activities and establishment units (BE), registre_hr, registre_cy (HE/AE numbers, legal persons only), registre_ee and gages_commerciaux, registres_fi, registre_ie, succursale_etrangere (LV: a struck-off branch whose parent is proven a legal person), registre_lt and fiscalite_lt, unites_locales (NO), registre_ro (legal persons only). Croatia, Czechia, Estonia, Latvia, Norway and Slovakia serve legal persons only, and Belgium its whitelist of forms with legal personality: a Belgian entity without legal form or of a form without legal personality, a Croatian sole trader (trgovac pojedinac) or undecided form, a sole trader's IČO, an Estonian sole proprietorship (FIE), a Latvian individual merchant (IK) or individual, family, farm or fishery enterprise, an establishment bearing a Latvian or foreign natural-person trader mark (e.K., FIE, toiminimi, sole trader…), a Norwegian sole proprietorship (ENK), registered individual (PERS, TVAM), estate (KBO, BO) or a foreign branch or entity (NUF, UTLA) whose name does not end with a written legal-person form valid in its home country (followed at most by branch words), or recorded there as a sole proprietorship, or a form not recognised as a legal person returns 404, not billed. A Swiss sole proprietorship (Einzelunternehmen), a Swiss branch whose head office is not served or an undecided form returns 404 too, not billed. So do, in Denmark (CVR), a sole proprietorship (ENK), a personally owned small business (PMV), an estate (DØD) or an undecided CVR form; in Lithuania, an individual enterprise (individuali įmonė, IĮ), its branch (individualios įmonės filialas) or representative office (individualios įmonės atstovybė), or an undecided form; in Sweden, a sole proprietorship (enskild näringsverksamhet) or an undecided form; in Romania, an authorised natural person or an individual or family enterprise (PFA, II, IF, PF, AF), never loaded, or an undecided form; and, in Finland, Ireland, Poland and the United Kingdom, a form outside the register's published nomenclature (a foreign trader's branch included). Through GLEIF, a LEI that GLEIF flags as a natural person (sole proprietor category or natural-person legal form) or of an ambiguous legal form returns 404, not billed, the same way; a LEI without ELF code is judged by its written legal form, and a LEI asked under another country than its own (jurisdiction; for a branch, legal address) returns 404 pays_ne_correspond_pas, not billed (never served under DE or NL). For LEI holders, groupe_lei is the GLEIF level-2 group: the direct and ultimate CONSOLIDATING parents (named, except a parent that GLEIF flags as a natural person or of an ambiguous legal form: mere_omise gives the reason, no name, no LEI; non_servie for any other reason) or the declared reason for having none (accounting consolidation, never ownership or beneficial owners; sans_objet without a LEI). Belgian, Croatian, Cypriot, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Romanian, Swedish and Swiss profiles also carry financements_ue (CORDIS projects matched by the published VAT number; sans_objet elsewhere). score_defaillance is non_evaluable (no score here yet; reasons: GET /v1/lecture), never a low score. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

id.description: National register identifier, e.g. 923609016. Spaces and up to 24 characters only for Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom; elsewhere letters, digits, dots and hyphens, up to 20. The VAT form only where it carries the register number (Belgium, Croatia, Czechia, Denmark, Finland, Latvia, Norway, Romania, Sweden and Switzerland); a VAT number that is another number (Estonia, Poland, Slovakia and the United Kingdom) is refused. 400 otherwise, not billed

pays.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. NO

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_european_company_profile

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
